findings.summary: Runner imports resume_lr_transition at module top level, but the transition module is not in the critical pin set or any registration path/pin binding.
findings.impact: Transition module code executes at process start, before load_registration verifies any pin. A swapped or drifted module runs unverified.
findings.fix: Add transition module path to registration, to critical set, and to pin binding; verify its sha before import or under a verified loader.

findings.summary: excluding-LR before fingerprint is computed after override over shared live tensors; non_lr_fields_changed is hard-coded []; publication assertion checks live optimizer, not the captured state['optimizer'] that is saved.
findings.impact: Record and assertion do not independently prove moment/state unchanged in the override window or the bytes saved. Override only writes group lr, so the claim is likely true but unproven by the record.
findings.fix: Digest excluding-LR view before override and store it; compute non_lr_fields_changed; also assert state['optimizer'] param_groups lr equals ARM_LR before save.

findings.summary: Archival parent_checkpoint_sha256 ce9c03c8d476f58d5edec9f95946fa808d1d65890728528f9a44993eb0f0544f is unlabeled in the config JSON; actual parent authority is 105e0f7a83e154116bd9f0d5eaaf573a896886468c9038f548f5ce7e6377c7ea via external pin.
findings.impact: A reader of the arm config alone gets a wrong parent checkpoint. Runner does not read the field (authority is PARENT_SHA).
findings.fix: Label the field as archival in the arm registration; do not change config bytes (one-variable diff preserved).
